events.title: Khan Kardam of Bulgaria defeats Constantine VI at Markellai
events.description: Near the fortress of Markellai, close to present-day Karnobat, the Bulgarians under Khan Kardam routed the Byzantine army of Emperor Constantine VI, who fled the field. Byzantium was forced to resume paying tribute to Bulgaria.

events.title: A relief army defeats Rollo's Vikings besieging Chartres
events.description: Rollo's Vikings, who had besieged Chartres in West Francia since spring, were defeated when a relief army arrived. The failure led to the Treaty of Saint-Clair-sur-Epte, by which King Charles the Simple granted Rollo lands around Rouen.

events.title: Richard I is invested as duke of Normandy
events.description: Richard I, known as the Lionheart, was officially invested as duke of Normandy. He was crowned king of England in Westminster Abbey on 3 September and became a leading commander of the Third Crusade.
events.html: Richard I, known as the Lionheart, was officially invested as duke of Normandy. He was crowned king of England in Westminster Abbey on 3 September and became a leading commander of the Third Crusade.

events.title: Berwick-upon-Tweed surrenders to Edward III
events.description: The Scottish-held town of Berwick-upon-Tweed surrendered to King Edward III of England after a four-month siege, once a Scottish relief army had been heavily defeated at Halidon Hill. The English-backed Edward Balliol then established his authority over most of Scotland.

events.title: Bogotá rises against Spanish rule
events.description: A quarrel over a borrowed flower vase sparked an uprising in Bogotá that created a governing junta. Colombia celebrates 20 July as its Independence Day; full independence came after Bolívar's victory in 1819.

events.title: Austria defeats Italy at Lissa, the first great ironclad battle
events.description: Admiral Tegetthoff's Austrian fleet defeated a larger Italian force off the island of Lissa in the Adriatic. The ramming of the Italian flagship convinced navies to fit rams to warships for decades.

events.title: Stauffenberg's bomb fails to kill Hitler
events.description: Colonel Claus von Stauffenberg left a briefcase bomb at Hitler's Wolf's Lair headquarters, but Hitler survived. The plotters were executed and thousands more were arrested in the reprisals that followed.
events.html: Colonel Claus von Stauffenberg left a briefcase bomb at Hitler's Wolf's Lair headquarters, but Hitler survived. The plotters were executed and thousands more were arrested in the reprisals that followed.

events.title: Apollo 11 lands on the Moon
events.description: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the lunar module Eagle in the Sea of Tranquillity. Hours later, at 10.56 pm US Eastern time, Armstrong stepped onto the surface, watched by some 600 million people.
events.html: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the lunar module Eagle in the Sea of Tranquillity. Hours later, at 10.56 pm US Eastern time, Armstrong stepped onto the surface, watched by some 600 million people.

events.title: Viking 1 makes the first successful landing on Mars
events.description: NASA's Viking 1 lander touched down on Chryse Planitia and sent back the first photographs from the Martian surface. It operated for more than six years.
